title: Unit coherence for higher pullback tensor comparisons
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, Ω an algebraic closure of Q_l, and f:X→Y a scheme morphism with l invertible on X and Y. Use the categories and operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison] and the normalized integral, rational and common-stage units and unitors of [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-constraints]. At each of these three coefficient levels there is a unique isomorphism from pullback of the source unit to the target unit for which both tensor-comparison/unit/unitor routes agree with pullback of the corresponding unitor, for every input object. These are exactly canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor_unit, canonicalRationalPullbackTensor_unit and canonicalCommonStagePullbackTensor_unit. The predicates and normalized constraints are those of [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-constraints].
